grades: Finished sophomore year of high school (first time in the program)
name: Young Scholars Program (UGA College of Agricultural and Environmental Sciences)
org: University of Georgia, College of Agricultural and Environmental Sciences
city: Athens, Griffin or Tifton, GA (UGA campuses)
what_you_do: This is a paid summer research internship. Students work 30 hours a week on supervised research with a UGA faculty mentor. Then they present a poster at a research conference.
who_can_apply: High school students who finished sophomore year and are 16 by the program start date. You must have taken one high school lab science course and one semester of algebra. You should be interested in ag, food and environmental science. First time participants only.
pay_detail: Described as a paid internship, 30 hours a week. The pay amount is not stated on the pages read.
duration: Five weeks (June 1 to July 7 on the page, plus a three day conference July 8 to 10). The page does not show the year.
deadline_text: Last cycle: application opened Nov 3, 2025 and closed Jan 23, 2026. The program page now says the application is closed for this cycle. Next cycle dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Send an online application with short essays. Pick a campus (Athens, Griffin or Tifton). Add two recommendation letters from science or math teachers. Upload an official transcript.
notes: Not residential. You must arrange your own housing and transport, and travel to the campus daily. Contacts on the page: Athens 706-542-2713, Griffin 770-228-7264, Tifton 229-326-4663. Georgia Department of Labor says a work permit is required only for minors who have not reached their 16th birthday. This program requires age 16.
